statements:
SELECT
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  SUM(AGG_REVENUE_MONTHLY.FREIGHT_REVENUES)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.AGG_REVENUE_MONTHLY  AGG_REVENUE_MONTHLY,
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_PERIODS  FISCAL_PERIODS
WHERE
  ( AGG_REVENUE_MONTHLY.PERIOD_ID=FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_ID  )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR

SELECT
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  SUM(GL_JOURNAL_LINES.REVENUE_AMOUNT),
  SUM(GL_JOURNAL_LINES.EXPENSE_AMOUNT),
  SUM(GL_JOURNAL_LINES.EXPENSE_AMOUNT)/NULLIF(SUM(GL_JOURNAL_LINES.REVENUE_AMOUNT),0)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_PERIODS  FISCAL_PERIODS,
  CNR_FIN.GL_JOURNAL_LINES  GL_JOURNAL_LINES
WHERE
  ( GL_JOURNAL_LINES.PERIOD_ID=FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_ID  )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR

SELECT
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_NUMBER,
  STATIONS.REGION,
  SUM(FREIGHT_BILLING.LINE_REVENUE),
  SUM(FREIGHT_BILLING.LINEHAUL_REVENUE),
  SUM(FREIGHT_BILLING.FUEL_SURCHARGE_REVENUE)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_PERIODS  FISCAL_PERIODS,
  CNR_FIN.FREIGHT_BILLING  FREIGHT_BILLING,
  CNR_FIN.STATIONS  STATIONS
WHERE
  ( FREIGHT_BILLING.ORIGIN_STATION_CODE=STATIONS.STATION_CODE  )
  AND  ( FREIGHT_BILLING.PERIOD_ID=FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_ID  )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_NUMBER,
  STATIONS.REGION
